title: BA2/136/2016 of Shamshad Alias Shambhu Vs State Of Uttarakhand

paras.text:
BA2. 136 of 2016
U. C. Dhyani, J.
Mr. Amit Kapri, Advocate present for the
applicant.
Mr. A.S. Gill, Learned Deputy Advocate
General, present for the State.
 List after the defects are removed.
Learned Counsel for the applicant seeks
permission to withdrawal the bail application.
Permission is granted.
As prayed, Bail Application is dismissed as
withdrawn with liberty to applicant to move an
application under Section 437 Cr PC at for applicants
released on bail before the Trial Court.
(U. C. Dhyani, J.) 22.09.2016 A.kaur

[By means of present writ petition, the
petitioner wanted to know the progress in the
investigation of criminal case pertaining to FIR no.
289/2013 under Sections 363, 366, 376, 504 and
506 IPC, P.S. Rudrapur, District Udham Singh
Nagar].
 Victim/petitioner lodged an FIR against
three named accused on 20.5.2013 for the offences
punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376, 504 and
506 IPC.
 When the petition was listed yesterday,
learned Deputy Advocate General was requested to
seek instructions and apprise the court about the
current status of the investigation.
 Learned Deputy Advocate General has
informed the court that after the investigation, a
final report has been submitted on 31.5.2014.
 In view of such submission of learned
Deputy Advocate General writ petition has become
infructuous and is disposed of as infructuous.
 (U. C. Dhyani, J.)
 19.11.2014
SH
